args.prompt: he clicks the dial on the white wand up with his thumb and grins at her; her cheeks flush pink as she giggles and bites her lip, then he clicks it back down and she bursts out laughing; the wand stays still in his hand and the background stays calm Painterly neo-noir graphic-novel animation: keep the hand-painted brushwork, ink lines and lighting of the first frame, same characters, faces and outfits throughout, smooth cinematic camera, no on-screen text changes.
args.negative_prompt: garbled or changing text, morphing faces, extra limbs, flicker, photorealistic, glossy 3D render, oversaturated neon, smoke or spray shooting out of objects, liquid, mist jets
